SELECT COUNT(*) AS workorderTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS workorderCompleted, SUM(CASE WHEN w.request_date IS NOT NULL AND w.request_date < NOW() AND (w.status <> 'COMPLETED' OR w.finish_date > w.request_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS workorderDelayed, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'PRODUCING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS workorderInProgress FROM qxx_pro_workorder w
w.create_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND w.status <> 'CANCEL'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qxx_pro_task t JOIN qxx_md_workstation ws ON ws.workstation_id = t.workstation_id AND ws.factory_id = t.factory_id WHERE t.workorder_id = w.workorder_id AND t.factory_id = w.factory_id AND ws.workshop_id IN #{id} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qxx_pro_feedback fb WHERE fb.workorder_id = w.workorder_id AND fb.factory_id = w.factory_id AND fb.team_id IN #{id} )

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(t.setup_duration,0) + IFNULL(t.unit_duration,0) * IFNULL(t.quantity_produced,0)),0) AS standardMinutes FROM qxx_pro_task t LEFT JOIN qxx_md_workstation ws ON ws.workstation_id = t.workstation_id AND ws.factory_id = t.factory_id
t.status <> 'CANCEL' AND (t.finish_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} OR t.status = 'PRODUCING')
AND ws.workshop_id IN #{id}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qxx_pro_feedback fb WHERE fb.workorder_id = t.workorder_id AND fb.factory_id = t.factory_id AND fb.team_id IN #{id} )

SELECT ws.workshop_id AS groupId, wshop.workshop_name AS groupName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.workorder_id) AS workorderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.workorder_id END) AS completedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.request_date IS NOT NULL AND w.request_date < NOW() AND (w.status <> 'COMPLETED' OR w.finish_date > w.request_date) THEN t.workorder_id END) AS delayedCount, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity),0) AS standardOutput, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity_produced),0) AS actualOutput, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(t.setup_duration,0) + IFNULL(t.unit_duration,0) * IFNULL(t.quantity_produced,0)),0) AS standardMinutes, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity_qualified),0) AS qualifiedQty, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity_unqualified),0) AS scrapQty FROM qxx_pro_task t JOIN qxx_md_workstation ws ON ws.workstation_id = t.workstation_id AND ws.factory_id = t.factory_id LEFT JOIN qxx_md_workshop wshop ON wshop.workshop_id = ws.workshop_id AND wshop.factory_id = t.factory_id LEFT JOIN qxx_pro_workorder w ON w.workorder_id = t.workorder_id AND w.factory_id = t.factory_id
(t.finish_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} OR t.status IN ('PRODUCING','NORMAL','PREPARE','PAUSED'))
GROUP BY ws.workshop_id, wshop.workshop_name

SELECT t.workstation_id AS groupId, MAX(t.workstation_name) AS groupName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.workorder_id) AS workorderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.workorder_id END) AS completedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.request_date IS NOT NULL AND w.request_date < NOW() AND (w.status <> 'COMPLETED' OR w.finish_date > w.request_date) THEN t.workorder_id END) AS delayedCount, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity),0) AS standardOutput, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity_produced),0) AS actualOutput, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(t.setup_duration,0) + IFNULL(t.unit_duration,0) * IFNULL(t.quantity_produced,0)),0) AS standardMinutes, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity_qualified),0) AS qualifiedQty, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity_unqualified),0) AS scrapQty FROM qxx_pro_task t LEFT JOIN qxx_md_workstation ws ON ws.workstation_id = t.workstation_id AND ws.factory_id = t.factory_id LEFT JOIN qxx_pro_workorder w ON w.workorder_id = t.workorder_id AND w.factory_id = t.factory_id
(t.finish_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} OR t.status IN ('PRODUCING','NORMAL','PREPARE','PAUSED'))
GROUP BY t.workstation_id

SELECT t.process_id AS groupId, MAX(t.process_name) AS groupName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.workorder_id) AS workorderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.workorder_id END) AS completedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.request_date IS NOT NULL AND w.request_date < NOW() AND (w.status <> 'COMPLETED' OR w.finish_date > w.request_date) THEN t.workorder_id END) AS delayedCount, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity),0) AS standardOutput, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity_produced),0) AS actualOutput, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(t.setup_duration,0) + IFNULL(t.unit_duration,0) * IFNULL(t.quantity_produced,0)),0) AS standardMinutes, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity_qualified),0) AS qualifiedQty, IFNULL(SUM(t.quantity_unqualified),0) AS scrapQty FROM qxx_pro_task t LEFT JOIN qxx_md_workstation ws ON ws.workstation_id = t.workstation_id AND ws.factory_id = t.factory_id LEFT JOIN qxx_pro_workorder w ON w.workorder_id = t.workorder_id AND w.factory_id = t.factory_id
(t.finish_date BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} OR t.status IN ('PRODUCING','NORMAL','PREPARE','PAUSED'))
GROUP BY t.process_id

SELECT fb.team_id AS groupId, MAX(fb.team_name) AS groupName, COUNT(DISTINCT fb.workorder_id) AS workorderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN fb.workorder_id END) AS completedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.request_date IS NOT NULL AND w.request_date < NOW() AND (w.status <> 'COMPLETED' OR w.finish_date > w.request_date) THEN fb.workorder_id END) AS delayedCount, IFNULL(SUM(fb.quantity),0) AS standardOutput, IFNULL(SUM(fb.quantity_feedback),0) AS actualOutput, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(t.setup_duration,0) + IFNULL(t.unit_duration,0) * IFNULL(fb.quantity_qualified,0)),0) AS standardMinutes, IFNULL(SUM(fb.quantity_qualified),0) AS qualifiedQty, IFNULL(SUM(fb.quantity_unqualified),0) AS scrapQty FROM qxx_pro_feedback fb LEFT JOIN qxx_pro_workorder w ON w.workorder_id = fb.workorder_id AND w.factory_id = fb.factory_id LEFT JOIN qxx_pro_task t ON t.task_id = fb.task_id AND t.factory_id = fb.factory_id
fb.status = 'AUDITED' AND fb.feedback_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND fb.team_id IS NOT NULL
AND fb.team_id IN #{id}
GROUP BY fb.team_id

SELECT r.workstation_id AS groupId, IFNULL(SUM(r.work_duration),0) AS actualMinutes FROM qxx_pro_workrecord r
r.status = 'CLOSED' AND r.clock_in_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}
AND r.workstation_id IN ( SELECT ws2.workstation_id FROM qxx_md_workstation ws2 WHERE ws2.factory_id = r.factory_id AND ws2.workshop_id IN #{id})
GROUP BY r.workstation_id

SELECT r.team_id AS groupId, MAX(r.team_name) AS groupName, IFNULL(SUM(r.work_duration),0) AS actualMinutes FROM qxx_pro_workrecord r
r.status = 'CLOSED' AND r.clock_in_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND r.team_id IS NOT NULL
AND r.team_id IN #{id}
GROUP BY r.team_id

SELECT DATE(w.create_time) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS createdCount FROM qxx_pro_workorder w
w.create_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} AND w.status <> 'CANCEL'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qxx_pro_task t JOIN qxx_md_workstation ws ON ws.workstation_id = t.workstation_id AND ws.factory_id = t.factory_id WHERE t.workorder_id = w.workorder_id AND t.factory_id = w.factory_id AND ws.workshop_id IN #{id} )
GROUP BY DATE(w.create_time)

SELECT w.workorder_id AS workorderId, w.workorder_code AS workorderCode, w.workorder_name AS workorderName, w.product_code AS productCode, w.product_name AS productName, w.quantity AS quantity, w.quantity_produced AS quantityProduced, w.request_date AS requestDate, w.finish_date AS finishDate, w.status AS status, ROUND(IFNULL(w.quantity_produced,0)/NULLIF(w.quantity,0)*100,0) AS completionRate FROM qxx_pro_workorder w
w.create_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qxx_pro_task t JOIN qxx_md_workstation ws ON ws.workstation_id = t.workstation_id AND ws.factory_id = t.factory_id WHERE t.workorder_id = w.workorder_id AND t.factory_id = w.factory_id AND ws.workshop_id = #{workshopId} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qxx_pro_feedback fb WHERE fb.workorder_id = w.workorder_id AND fb.factory_id = w.factory_id AND fb.team_id = #{teamId})
ORDER BY w.create_time DESC
